retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait with a gritty halftone texture, featuring bold slab-serif typography and a secondary miniature group scene at the base.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a large, high-contrast monochrome portrait of a male figure with a microphone. The image features a visible halftone dot pattern and is framed by bold, wide slab-serif text at the top and bottom. A smaller, high-contrast group shot is integrated into the bottom left corner, creating a dual-scale narrative.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale portrait vs. small-scale group silhouette
Monochrome photographic base vs. vibrant red title text
Heavy slab-serif headers vs. fine-detail halftone texture
Centralized subject vs. edge-to-edge typographic framing
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white halftone photographic texture
Bold slab-serif typography with thin white outlines
Red fill for primary title characters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up portrait centered horizontally, occupying 80% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the central figure and the large red title text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves down the face to the microphone, then to the small group scene at the bottom left, finishing at the bottom text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with photographic detail and large-scale type.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome portrait of a male singer with a microphone, applying a coarse halftone dot texture. Include a small group of musicians and a vintage car in the bottom left corner as a high-contrast silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, wide slab-serif text in uppercase at the top and bottom. The top text should be red with a thin white outline; the bottom text should be solid white.
